name: Atlassian teamwork pack
description: Everything a team migrating from Jira and Confluence needs on day one: connectors for both, a seeded project and wiki space, ready test cases, deep links back to the originals, and a macro that shows an issue's state on a wiki page. Declarative — no code runs.

api_token.title: API token
api_token.description: A reference to the secret holding your Atlassian API token. The token itself is never stored in the extension.

items.title: Team home
items.content:
# Team home

What this team owns, who to ask, and where the important things live.

## Services we own

| Service | On call | Runbook |
|---------|---------|---------|
| payments-api | payments@example.org | [Runbook](/wiki) |

## How we work

- Every change goes through a merge request.
- Anything user-visible needs a test case linked to its issue.

items.title: Decision record: why we moved off Jira
items.content:
# Decision record: why we moved off Jira

**Status:** accepted

## Context

Issues, test cases and the mocks they exercise lived in three products. Tracing a failing test back to the requirement meant three tabs and a guess.

## Decision

Keep the tracker, the test cases and the mocks in one place, and link them to each other.

## Consequences

- Old Jira links must keep resolving — hence the deep links this pack installs.
- The team learns one search box instead of three.

items.title: Runbook: payments-api is failing
items.content:
# Runbook: payments-api is failing

1. Check the dashboard for the error rate and which endpoint is failing.
2. Replay the failing request against the mock to see whether the contract changed.
3. If the contract changed, open a defect and link it to the contract.
4. If it did not, escalate to the on-call engineer for payments.

Follow the deep link back to the original

items.name: A wiki page renders the issue macro
items.expectedResult: The macro shows the issue key and its current state, not raw text.

steps.action: Insert the issue-status macro for a migrated issue
steps.expectedResult: The badge shows the issue key and state.

items.name: Attachments survived the import
